final: WITH per_frequency AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount * 1.0 ELSE -t.amount * 1.0 END) AS signed_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.frequency), overall AS (SELECT AVG(signed_avg) AS mean_signed_avg FROM per_frequency) SELECT AVG(p.signed_avg) AS avg_signed_avg, AVG(p.balance_avg) AS avg_balance_avg, AVG(p.signed_avg - o.mean_signed_avg) AS avg_excess FROM per_frequency AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.signed_avg > o.mean_signed_avg
